full_prompt_en: A square editorial cover design places a large right-facing profile silhouette made from hundreds of tiny image fragments above the word "TIME" on a pale background. The background is almost entirely warm off-white, leaving broad open margins at the top and on both sides. In the upper center, the profile is recognizable from its forehead, nose, lips, and chin at the right edge. Its surface is not a single photograph; it is packed with small overlapping scenes, faces, buildings, uniforms, and earth-colored marks. Near the lower middle of that profile, one helmeted figure is more visible than the surrounding fragments, while other faces and events merge into the dense collage around it. The right outline remains relatively solid, especially along the nose and jaw. Toward the left, the back of the head breaks into scattered dark flecks that thin gradually into the white space. That dispersal gives the otherwise static silhouette an outward drifting motion. Small flashes of blue, green, and warm red appear inside an overall range of brown, charcoal, tan, and muted gold. A faint gray shadow falls to the lower right of the collage, lifting it slightly from the pale page. Across the lower third, the large serif letters "TIME" are centered on one line. The letters are filled with the same broken image texture as the profile, with thin red accents along parts of their upper edges. The type has generous space around it and no smaller readable cover lines. Light is clean and diffuse across the page; contrast comes from the dense colored fragments against the quiet white ground rather than from a dramatic spotlight. Tiny photographic textures make the image intricate close up, while the bold profile and four large letters stay immediately legible from a distance. The overall composition is spare but information-rich, balancing a dissolving human silhouette against monumental typography for a reflective editorial mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形编辑封面设计在浅色背景上放置一个由数百个细小影像碎片构成、面向右侧的巨大侧脸剪影，下方是“TIME”一词。背景几乎完全是暖灰白色，在顶部和两侧留下宽阔空白。上部中央，这个侧影通过右侧的额头、鼻子、嘴唇与下巴变得可辨。其表面并非单张照片，而是挤满相互重叠的小场景、面孔、建筑、制服和土色痕迹。在侧影下部中央附近，一个戴头盔的人物比周围碎片更清楚，其他面孔与事件则融入密集拼贴。右侧轮廓相对完整，尤其是鼻梁与下颌。朝左，后脑勺碎裂成散落的深色细屑，逐渐稀疏并消入白色空间。这种消散让原本静止的剪影仿佛向外飘动。总体棕色、炭黑、浅褐与低饱和金色之中，闪出少量蓝、绿和暖红。拼贴右下侧投出淡淡灰影，使它略微浮离浅色纸面。下方三分之一处，大号衬线字母“TIME”居中排成一行。字母内部填满与侧影相同的破碎影像肌理，部分上缘带细薄的红色重音。字体四周留有宽裕空间，没有更小的可读封面文字。页面上的光线干净而漫射，对比来自密集彩色碎片与安静白底，而非戏剧性的聚光。细小摄影纹理使画面在近处复杂精密，大胆的侧脸与四个大字则在远处仍一眼可读。整体构图简洁却信息丰厚，以逐渐消散的人物剪影平衡纪念碑式排字，形成沉思的编辑气氛。
style_prompt_en: The editorial graphic combines large symbolic silhouettes, microscopic photographic collage, and monumental serif typography. A very pale open ground surrounds one dense central mass, making the whole design readable before its small fragments are examined. Within the main shape, numerous miniature scenes and tonal flecks overlap in brown, charcoal, muted gold, and occasional cool color. One edge stays crisp enough to identify the form, while the opposite edge dissolves into scattered particles and generous negative space. Strong type can repeat the collage texture, binding word and image through material rather than through extra ornament. Soft diffuse illumination and a faint offset shadow give the layered surface slight lift without distracting from the flat cover layout. A small red accent sharpens the otherwise restrained neutral palette. The overall effect is authoritative and reflective, with a simple distant read that rewards close inspection through intricate documentary texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种编辑图形结合大型象征性剪影、微小摄影拼贴与纪念碑式衬线排字。极浅而开放的底色环绕一个密集中央体块，使整体设计在小碎片被辨认之前就可读。在主要形状内部，大量微型场景和明暗细屑以棕色、炭黑、低饱和金色及偶尔的冷色互相覆盖。一侧边缘保持足够清晰以辨认形体，另一侧则消散为零星颗粒与宽裕留白。大字可以重复拼贴肌理，让文字与图像通过材料而非额外装饰相联。柔和漫射光和轻微错位阴影使层叠表面略微浮起，却不分散对平面封面布局的注意。少量红色重音使原本克制的中性色域更锐利。整体效果权威而沉思，远看简洁明白，近看则以复杂的纪实纹理回报细读。
theme_en: A profile silhouette assembled from news-image fragments above the word TIME
theme_zh: 由新闻影像碎片拼成的侧面剪影，下面是 TIME 字样
name: Time magazine
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
